KPI_1.name: S0 Opportunities Created Count for New Customer and Existing Customer Expansion
KPI_1.description: Tracks the count of S0 stage opportunities created for both new customer acquisition and existing customer expansion opportunities.

KPI_2.name: S1 Opportunities Created Count for New Customer and Existing Customer Expansion
KPI_2.description: Measures the count of S1 stage opportunities created for both new customer acquisition and existing customer expansion opportunities.

KPI_3.name: S3 Opportunities Created Count for New Customer and Existing Customer Expansion with Positive ACV
KPI_3.description: Tracks the count of S3 stage opportunities created for both new and existing customers with positive starting ACV values.

KPI_4.name: M1 Opportunities Created Count for New Customer and Existing Customer Expansion
KPI_4.description: Measures the count of M1 stage opportunities created for both new customer acquisition and existing customer expansion opportunities.

KPI_5.name: MQLs Count Excluding Mode Migration Sources
KPI_5.description: Tracks the total count of Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs) excluding those from mode migration sources.

KPI_6.name: Total Opportunity ACV for Closed Won Opportunities with Positive ACV
KPI_6.description: Measures the total Annual Contract Value (ACV) for opportunities that have reached the closed won stage with positive ACV values.

KPI_7.name: S1 Starting ACV for New Customer and Existing Customer Expansion with Positive ACV
KPI_7.description: Tracks the total starting ACV for S1 stage opportunities across both new customer and existing customer expansion deals with positive values.

KPI_8.name: S3 Starting ACV for New Customer and Existing Customer Expansion with Positive ACV
KPI_8.description: Measures the total starting ACV for S3 stage opportunities across both new customer and existing customer expansion deals with positive values.

KPI_9.name: Free Trial Users Count for Web Free Trial Source
KPI_9.description: Tracks the unique count of users who started free trials through web sources, excluding teams edition subscriptions.

KPI_10.name: S0 Starting ACV for New Customer and Existing Customer Expansion with Positive ACV
KPI_10.description: Measures the total starting ACV for S0 stage opportunities across both new customer and existing customer expansion deals with positive values.

attributes: Opportunity Type, Booking Target Geo (by BT RegSeg), Opportunity Source MQL Classification, Creation Target Geo, BT Region Segment (split) by Owner team (FY'26)
goal: Monitor sales pipeline performance and revenue achievement against quarterly targets to ensure business growth objectives are met.
user_context: CMO and marketing executives use this dashboard during quarterly business reviews and weekly leadership meetings to comprehensively assess marketing performance across the full customer acquisition funnel, starting with top-level quarterly bookings versus targets analysis through the pivot table breakdown by geography, opportunity source, segment, and deployment type, then drilling down into lead generation metrics by examining MQL creation trends and classifications to understand which marketing channels and campaigns are driving qualified leads, followed by pipeline progression analysis where they track conversion rates and stage duration from M1 through S7 to identify bottlenecks and optimize sales processes, while also monitoring trial user engagement and conversion metrics to evaluate product-led growth initiatives, and finally conducting pipeline coverage analysis to ensure adequate future quarter targets can be met, requiring them to ignore outlier data points in early-stage metrics that may not yet reflect true conversion patterns and focus on consistent quarter-over-quarter trends rather than month-to-month fluctuations when making strategic decisions about budget allocation and resource deployment.
